title: Mechanizing the User's Eye: Pre-Registered Deployment of a Sabotage-Validated Fail-Plausible Observer in a Production LLM Agent Runtime
title_zh: 将用户视角机制化：在量产 LLM 智能体运行时部署经破坏验证、具备失败合理性伪装能力的观察者的预注册方案

paragraphs.en: In a previous longitudinal study of silent failures in a production LLM agent runtime ( When Errors Become Narratives , arXiv:2606.14589) we reported an uncomfortable finding: roughly 70% of silent failures were ultimately discovered by a human looking at the product as a user, while thousands of unit tests and hundreds of governance checks stayed green — and we posed mechanizing even part of what the human eye does as an open problem. This paper reports our attempt. We built an automated user-viewpoint observer targeting the taxonomy’s most dangerous class, fail-plausible failure, in which the system transforms an internal error into fluent, plausible output delivered to the user.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项关于生产环境中 LLM 智能体运行时静默故障的纵向研究（《当错误成为叙事》，arXiv:2606.14589）中，我们报告了一个令人不安的发现：大约 70% 的静默故障最终是由以用户身份查看产品的人类发现的，而数千个单元测试和数百项治理检查的结果却始终显示为通过——同时，我们将如何将人类视觉所完成的部分工作实现自动化，作为一个开放性问题提出。 本文报告了我们的尝试。 我们构建了一个自动化的用户视角观察器，针对该分类体系中最危险的一类故障——“看似合理的失败”——进行监测；在此类故障中，系统会将内部错误转化为流畅且看似合理的输出并交付给用户。

sents.en: We built an automated user-viewpoint observer targeting the taxonomy’s most dangerous class, fail-plausible failure, in which the system transforms an internal error into fluent, plausible output delivered to the user.

paragraphs.en: The observer is a two-layer pipeline: five deterministic signals distilled from incident postmortems escalate to an LLM judge whose verdicts must cite verbatim evidence from the artifact or be discarded. Ground truth comes from 24 labeled production postmortems, with explicit honesty boundaries — 16 of 24 incidents are structurally invisible to any content-reading observer, and we say so rather than claim them. Offline, the deterministic layer achieves 6/6 regression detection with 0/4 false positives, every detector proven load-bearing by sabotage; held-out recall on novel patterns is 0/4. The observer is, so far, a regression engine, and the scorecard reports that without spin.
paragraphs.zh: 该观察者是一个双层管道：从已发生的故障分析中提炼出的五个确定性信号会升级至一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判，其裁决必须逐字引用来自人工制品的证据，否则将被舍弃。 基准事实来自 24 个带有标签的生产环境故障分析，并设定了明确的诚实性边界——在这 24 起事件中，有 16 起在结构上对任何读取内容的观察者都是不可见的，我们明确说明这一点，而非声称它们存在。 在线下环境中，确定性层实现了 6/6 的回归检测率且无假阳性（0/4），所有检测器均通过破坏测试证明了其承载能力；而在新型模式上的保留召回率为 0/4。 目前而言，该观察者仍是一个回归引擎，而评分表也如实报告了这一结果，没有夸大其词。

paragraphs.en: Deployment followed a protocol borrowed from experimental science: pre-registration . Shadow mode caught and retired one systematic false positive on its first production run, after which the registered 26-day shadow window ran clean; flip criteria were registered before the shadow data was read; the analysis protocol — regime rules, exclusion rules, a negative-results commitment — was frozen before the enforcing-mode window opened. That window (12 observed days) fired zero verdicts: per the pre-registered path we report live precision as undefined (zero denominator) rather than narrating quiet as success. Meanwhile the observer produced ten silent failures of its own during its development — including polluting its own evidence file, an enforcing-mode integration that was silently inert, and twice accusing a working mechanism of failure — empirically confirming the prior paper’s warning that the judge inherits the taxonomy it judges. We release the labeled corpus, detector, and scorecard as a community-runnable bench, and argue that what mechanization buys today is retiring the human’s regression scanning so the human eye can specialize in novelty — prediction remains open, but it is now measurable, under rules already frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 部署遵循了从实验科学中借鉴而来的协议：预先注册。 在首次生产运行中，影子模式捕获并淘汰了一个系统性的假阳性结果；此后，已注册的为期26天的影子窗口运行良好。翻转标准在读取影子数据前就已注册；分析协议——包括机制规则、排除规则以及对负面结果的承诺——在启用模式窗口开启前即已固定。 该窗口（实际观测12天）未产生任何判定：根据预先注册的路径，我们将实时精度报告为“未定义”（分母为零），而非将静默状态描述为成功。 与此同时，该观察器在其开发阶段也出现了十起自身的静默故障——包括污染其自身的证据文件、一个在启用模式下静默无效的集成，以及两次错误指控正常运行的机制存在故障——这实证验证了先前论文中的警告：评判者会继承其所评判的分类体系。 我们公开了带标签的语料库、检测器和评分表，作为一个可供社区运行的基准工具，并主张当前机制化带来的好处是淘汰人类的回归扫描工作，从而让人眼能够专注于识别新颖性——预测问题仍然开放，但如今已在既定规则下变得可测量。

paragraphs.en: The predecessor to this paper documented 22 production incidents in a continuously operating LLM agent runtime and derived a five-class taxonomy of silent failures — failures whose error signal never reaches a human in actionable form [ 1 ] . Its headline empirical finding doubled as its largest open problem. Across the corpus, roughly 70% of silent failures were finally discovered by a human reading the product as a user : noticing that a digest “looked shallow,” that a signal section and an action section did not match, that yesterday’s analysis never arrived. The automated stack — at the time 4,286 unit tests, 827 governance checks, a 19-point preflight — stayed green through most incidents. We institutionalized a weekly 30-minute user-view observation ritual, watched it out-detect the automation for two more months, and wrote:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的前驱研究记录了一个持续运行的 LLM 智能体运行时发生的 22 起生产事故，并据此提出了一种包含五类的静默故障分类体系——即那些错误信号从未以可执行形式传达给人类的故障 [ 1 ]。 其核心的实证发现同时也是其最大的开放性问题。 在整个语料库中，大约 70% 的静默故障最终是由用户阅读产品时发现的：他们注意到摘要“显得浅显”，信号部分与操作部分不匹配，或者昨天的分析从未出现。 自动化系统——当时包括 4,286 个单元测试、827 项治理检查和一个包含 19 个项目的预飞检查——在大多数事故中始终保持正常状态。 我们建立了一项每周 30 分钟的用户视角观察流程，观察到它在接下来的两个月里比自动化系统更有效地检测出故障，并据此写道：

paragraphs.en: “for practitioners, user-view observation is a first-class observability signal and deserves calendar time; for researchers, the open problem is mechanizing even part of what the human eye does here.”
paragraphs.zh: “对于从业者而言，用户视角的观察是一种一等一的可观察性信号，值得投入专门的时间；而对于研究人员来说，一个尚未解决的问题是，如何将人类眼睛在此处所完成的部分功能实现机械化。”

paragraphs.en: This paper reports what happened when we tried. We scoped the attempt to the taxonomy’s Class D — fail-plausible failure, in which an LLM system does not merely fail to report an error but transforms it into coherent, contextually appropriate, false output [ 5 ] . Fail-plausible incidents are the ones the human eye caught that nothing else could have: a fabricated “platform crisis” analysis synthesized from captured error pages; fabricated OS remediation instructions woven from stale alert context; a fallback path manufacturing plausible-shaped review content in shell. They are semantic failures. Detecting them requires reading content , not status codes — which is precisely why the test/check stack scored ≈ 0 % {\approx}0\% on them.
paragraphs.zh: 本文报告了我们尝试时发生的事情。 我们将这次尝试的范围限定在分类法中的 D 类——即“失败看似合理”的故障，在这种情况下，LLM 系统不仅未能报告错误，还将错误转化为连贯且符合语境的虚假输出 [5]。 “失败看似合理”的事件正是人类肉眼能够察觉而其他任何手段都无法发现的：从捕获的错误页面中合成的虚构“平台危机”分析；由过时的警报上下文编织出的虚构操作系统修复指令；以及在 shell 中生成看似合理的审查内容的备用路径。 这些是语义层面的故障。 检测它们需要阅读内容，而非状态码——这正是测试/检查堆栈在这些故障上的得分约为 0% {\approx}0\% 的原因。

paragraphs.en: Three design commitments distinguish our attempt from a generic LLM-as-judge deployment:
paragraphs.zh: 有三项设计原则将我们的尝试与普通的“大型语言模型作为裁判”部署区分开来：

paragraphs.en: First, determinism before semantics. The observer is a two-layer pipeline. Layer 1 is five deterministic signals (error-code pollution, credibility mismatch, blood-lesson fabrication phrases, provenance gaps, structural incoherence), each distilled from a specific documented incident, each cheap, each explainable, each sabotage-validated — disabling a rule must make the historical incident it guards slip through, or the rule is dead weight. Layer 2, an LLM judge, runs only on escalation, and its verdicts must cite evidence that appears verbatim in the artifact under judgment; ungrounded evidence is dropped, and a verdict left without grounded evidence is downgraded to clean. The grounding rule exists because our own observer hallucinated a defect within its first week of operation (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 首先，语义之前是决定论。 观察者是双层管道结构。 第一层包含五个决定论信号（错误代码污染、可信度不匹配、血泪教训的虚构表述、来源缺失和结构不连贯），每个信号都源自特定的记录在案的事件，且每个信号都易于实现、易于解释，并经过破坏性验证——禁用某条规则必须导致其所保护的过往事件得以通过，否则该规则就是累赘。 第二层是一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判，仅在情况升级时运行，其裁决必须引用在受审产物中逐字出现的证据；无根据的证据将被舍弃，而缺乏依据的裁决将被降级为“干净”状态。 这条依据规则之所以存在，是因为我们自己的观察者在运行第一周内就幻觉出了一个缺陷（第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: Second, ground truth with honesty boundaries. The prior paper’s 22-incident postmortem corpus (since grown to 24 labeled incidents) is, to our knowledge, the only longitudinal, causally annotated silent-failure corpus for a production LLM agent system. We turned it into a labeled validation set — and found that only 3 of 24 incidents are cleanly within a content-reading observer’s reach, with 5 more partially so. The remaining 16 have no user-facing semantic artifact at all: deployment omissions, OS sandbox denials, a gateway dying silently. An observer that reads pushed content is structurally blind to them. We label this per-incident ( observer_in_scope ) rather than let the observer implicitly claim the whole corpus.

paragraphs.en: Third, pre-registration. Promoting a detector from shadow observation to enforcing mode — where its verdicts affect quality scores and page a human — is a decision with real costs in both directions, taken by the same people who built the detector and want it to succeed. That is a textbook motivated-reasoning surface. We imported the remedy experimental science uses [ 8 ] : flip criteria registered before reading shadow data; an analysis protocol (regime rules, exclusion rules, what counts as a true/false positive, and a commitment to publish negative results) frozen before the enforcing-mode window opened; and mechanical execution of those rules when the data arrived — including the rule applications that hurt (§ 6.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第三，预先注册。 将检测器从影子观察模式提升至执行模式——即其裁决会影响质量分数并通知人类——这一决定在两种方向上都会产生实际成本，而做出这一决定的人正是构建该检测器并希望其成功的人。 这是一个教科书式的动机推理表层现象。 我们引入了实验科学所采用的解决方案 [8]：在读取影子数据之前重新设定标准；在执行模式窗口开启前冻结分析协议（包括规则制度、排除规则、何为真阳性/假阳性，以及承诺公布负面结果）；并在数据到达时机械地执行这些规则——包括那些造成负面影响的具体规则应用（§ 6.6）。

paragraphs.en: An observer architecture (§ 3 ) for fail-plausible detection — deterministic pre-filter, evidence-grounded LLM judge, read-only by construction, integrated into an existing daily observation job rather than added as a new one.

paragraphs.en: A sabotage-validated offline scorecard and community bench (§ 5 ): 6/6 regression detection, 0/4 false positives, 0/4 held-out recall — the last number reported as an honest measurement of the description → \rightarrow prediction gap, not gated away.

paragraphs.en: The observer’s own incident log (§ 7 ): ten silent failures the observer itself produced during development — including contaminating its own evidence file, an enforcing-mode integration that was silently inert, and two confident false accusations against a mechanism it guards — which we offer as the strongest empirical support yet for the prior paper’s claim that an LLM judge inherits every failure class of the system it judges.

paragraphs.en: We close (§ 8 ) with what we think mechanization has actually bought: not prediction — held-out recall is 0/4 offline and untested live — but the retirement of the human’s regression scanning . The human eye is repositioned where the audit-as-regression argument says it is irreplaceable: novelty. Whether the instrument can cross from regression to prediction is now a measurable question with frozen rules, an open bench, and a corpus that grows with every incident.

paragraphs.en: When Errors Become Narratives [ 1 ] derived five mechanism classes from 22 production incidents: (A) environment/platform quirks, (B) design-assumption mismatches, (C) error swallowing and dilution, (D) chained hallucination and fabrication — fail-plausible — and (E) operational omission and forensic blind spots. Three cross-cutting findings matter here. Discovery : ∼ 70 % {\sim}70\% of incidents were caught by human user-view observation; tests and checks ≈ 0 % {\approx}0\% for this failure class. Audit is a regression engine : a retrospective audit found 0% ex-ante prevention but 87% ex-post regression blocking — audits encode the past, and prevention of novel classes must come from elsewhere. Seams, not components : the longest-lived failures inhabited the seams between correct parts (deployment topology, cross-script contracts, observer–observed coupling), where by construction no test runs. All three findings constrain the present work: the observer targets the discovery gap, is honestly framed as a regression engine with predictive ambitions, and is itself a new seam — which § 7 shows is not a hypothetical concern.

paragraphs.en: LLM judges reach striking agreement with human preference on open-ended quality [ 4 ] , which grounds the hope that an LLM can read a digest the way a user would. But the judge literature also documents self-preference: LLM evaluators recognize and favor their own generations [ 9 ] . Our setting is a close cousin of that hazard — the observer judges outputs produced by sibling LLM pipelines in the same runtime, is configured by the same operators, and (the prior paper’s warning) is itself an LLM component inheriting every taxonomy class . Our response is architectural rather than aspirational: determinism first (Layer 1 verdicts are lexical and auditable), verbatim evidence grounding for the LLM layer (§ 3.3 ), read-only operation enforced as a standing rule, and the same sabotage validation applied to the observer as to everything else. Section 7 reports how many times those constraints earned their keep.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 评判者在开放式质量评估方面与人类偏好惊人地一致 [4]，这让我们有理由相信，LLM 能够像用户一样阅读摘要。 但相关研究也记录了自我偏好的现象：LLM 评判者会识别并偏爱自己生成的内容 [9]。 我们的设置与该风险密切相关——观察者评判的是由同一运行环境中兄弟 LLM 流程生成的输出，这些流程由相同的操作员配置，并且（正如前一篇论文所警告的）观察者本身也是一个继承了所有分类类别的 LLM 组件。 我们的应对方案侧重于架构而非理想目标：首先确保确定性（第 1 层的评判基于词汇且可审计），为 LLM 层提供逐字证据支持（§3.3），强制执行只读操作作为固定规则，并对观察者应用与对其他所有组件相同的破坏性验证。 第 7 节报告了这些约束条件在多大程度上发挥了作用。

paragraphs.en: Pre-registration — committing to hypotheses and analysis plans before observing data — exists because analytic flexibility plus motivated reasoning reliably manufactures positive results [ 8 ] . Software engineering has already imported the instrument on the publication side: registered reports, where a study protocol is peer-reviewed before results exist, have run as a track at MSR since 2020 and are established at several SE venues [ 10 ] . Our use is adjacent but distinct — the pre-registration here is an operational one, binding an engineering decision (promote a detector from shadow to enforcing) and its post-hoc measurement, with the team itself as the only reviewer and a production system rather than a study as the object.
paragraphs.zh: 预先注册——即在观察数据之前对假设和分析计划做出承诺——之所以存在，是因为分析上的灵活性加上动机性推理能够可靠地制造出阳性结果 [ 8 ]。 软件工程在出版环节已经引入了这一工具：注册报告（registered reports），即研究方案在结果产生前就经过同行评审。自 2020 年以来，微软研究实验室（MSR）一直将其作为一个专题栏目运行，且该模式已在多个软件工程会议中确立 [ 10 ]。 我们的应用与之相近但有所不同——此处的预先注册是一种操作性的预先注册，它约束了一项工程决策（将检测器从“影子”状态提升至“执行”状态）及其事后的测量，其中团队本身是唯一的评审方，而对象则是一个生产系统而非一项研究。

sents.zh: 我们的应用与之相近但有所不同——此处的预先注册是一种操作性的预先注册，它约束了一项工程决策（将检测器从“影子”状态提升至“执行”状态）及其事后的测量，其中团队本身是唯一的评审方，而对象则是一个生产系统而非一项研究。

paragraphs.en: Observability engineering has the same disease surface as empirical research, with different symptoms: the team that builds a detector decides when it is “ready,” interprets its early signals, and later writes the narrative. Existing runtime-guard frameworks for LLM systems specify what a guard enforces — programmable rails and policy DSLs [ 11 ] — but not how a team should decide, in advance and against its own incentives, that a guard has earned enforcement authority. We did not find a report of a production observability component deployed under an explicitly pre-registered protocol of the kind we describe (shadow criteria, flip criteria, frozen analysis rules, negative-results commitment), and we make the weaker claim that this is uncommon rather than unprecedented. We describe ours in § 6 in enough detail to be reused, and we report the three occasions where the frozen rules overrode what narrative convenience would have preferred (§ 6.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 可观测性工程与经验研究存在相同的“问题表面”，但症状不同：构建检测器的团队会决定其何时“准备就绪”，解释其早期信号，并最终撰写叙述。 现有的 LLM 系统运行时守护框架会明确守护机制所强制执行的内容——例如可编程的约束和政策 DSL [11]——但并未说明团队应如何提前且违背自身激励，判断一个守护机制是否获得了执行权。 我们尚未发现任何关于生产环境中可观测性组件部署的报告符合我们所描述的这种明确预注册协议（如影子标准、翻转标准、冻结分析规则或负面结果承诺），因此我们仅提出一个较弱的论断：这种情况虽不常见，但并非前所未有。 我们在第 6 节中对我们的方法进行了足够详细的描述以便复用，并报告了三次冻结规则覆盖了叙述便利性所倾向结果的案例（第 6.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Gray failure named the cloud-era gap between an application’s experience and its observer’s view — differential observability [ 2 ] . The prior paper positioned fail-plausible as the LLM-era escalation: the observer is not starved of signal but fed a counterfeit one. Under that framing, the present work is an attempt to give the human’s side of the differential a mechanical ally on the semantic axis — a detector that reads the counterfeit the way the deceived human eventually does, but on a daily clock. MAST [ 3 ] and related agent-failure taxonomies characterize what goes wrong inside agent traces; our observer instead watches the products of an agent system in operation, because that is where fail-plausible manifests and where the human eye historically caught it.
paragraphs.zh: Gray failure 将云时代中应用程序体验与其观察者视角之间的差异称为「差异可观察性」[ 2 ]。 先前论文将 fail-plausible 视为大语言模型时代的升级形式：观察者并未缺乏信号，而是被喂食了虚假信号。 在此框架下，本研究试图在语义轴上为人类一方提供差异的机械盟友——一种能够像受骗者最终那样识别虚假信号的检测器，且能持续运行。 MAST [ 3 ] 及相关智能体故障分类体系描述了智能体追踪中出错的部分；而我们的观察者则关注智能体系统运行所产生的结果，因为 fail-plausible 正是在那里显现，并且历史上人类也正是通过观察这些结果发现了它。

paragraphs.en: Read-only. The observer never mutates what it observes. The system’s convergence engine — an audit that applied fixes — caused three incidents before being caged behind a dry-run default, yielding the standing rule “audit observes, never mutates.” The observer is born under that rule.

paragraphs.en: Extend, don’t parallel. The runtime already ran a daily LLM critique job (06:30, quality heuristics, prose output for humans). The fail-plausible detector is wired into that job — same scan, same report, same status plumbing — rather than shipped as a second observer. A parallel observer would add a new job, a new status file, a new watchdog contract, and an observer–observer seam; the prior paper’s complexity argument (add a part, add seams) forbids it.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展，而非并行。 运行时已经运行了每日的 LLM 批判任务（06:30，质量启发式规则，为人类生成散文输出）。 故障合理性检测器已集成到该任务中——相同的扫描、相同的报告、相同的状态管道——而不是作为第二个观察者独立部署。 一个并行的观察者会增加一个新的任务、一个新的状态文件、一个新的看管契约，以及观察者之间的接口；而前一篇论文中关于复杂性的论点（增加一个部分，就增加接口）禁止了这种做法。

paragraphs.en: Evidence or silence. Layer 2 verdicts must cite evidence that appears verbatim in the artifact. paragraphs.en: Sampling-aware. Large artifacts are sampled (head + tail with an explicit elision marker) before being shown to the judge, and the judge is told so. This constraint was learned, not designed: the observer’s first false accusation was a hallucinated “truncation” at exactly the sampling boundary (§ 7 , O2).

paragraphs.en: Each signal is a deterministic rule over artifact text, each with a named incident it would have caught — the corpus is not just evaluation data; it is the design source (Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个信号都是针对人工制品文本的一条确定性规则，每条规则都对应一个它本应检测到的命名事件——语料库不仅仅是评估数据，更是设计来源（图1）。

paragraphs.en: Two properties matter more than the rules themselves. Reuse : S2, S3, and S4 do not re-implement their knowledge — they import the runtime’s existing provenance-tier module and anti-fabrication guard ladder, so the observer and the generation-side defenses share one source of truth and cannot drift apart. Sabotage validation : disabling any rule must cause the specific historical artifact it guards to slip from flagged to clean (§ 5 ); a rule that survives its own disabling is indistinguishable from dead code and is treated as such.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个特性比规则本身更为重要。 重用：S2、S3 和 S4 不会重新实现其知识——它们导入运行时现有的来源层级模块和反伪造防护阶梯，因此观察方与生成方的防御机制共享单一真相源，无法产生偏差。 破坏验证：禁用任何规则都必须导致其所守护的特定历史产物从“已标记”状态变为“干净”状态（§ 5）；若一条规则在自身被禁用后仍能存活，则它与死代码无异，并将被如此对待。

paragraphs.en: When Layer 1 fires, the artifact (with sampling disclosure) goes to an LLM judge with a dedicated system prompt scoring four dimensions, each a fingerprint of a documented incident family:

paragraphs.zh: 依据性——每个事实性陈述都能从原始材料中得到支持吗？

paragraphs.en: The prompt injects the runtime’s own anti-fabrication guard text and source-credibility tiers — the judge is constrained by the same rules the generators are. The verdict parser then enforces the grounding rule mechanically: every evidence snippet the judge cites is searched for, verbatim, in the artifact; snippets not found are discarded; a fail-plausible verdict with no surviving grounded evidence is downgraded to clean. The rule costs recall and we accept that: an observer for fabrication that itself fabricates evidence is self-refuting, and ours demonstrably tried (§ 7 , O2).
paragraphs.zh: 该提示注入了运行时自身的反伪造防护文本和来源可信度层级——裁判受到与生成器相同的规则约束。 随后，判决解析器会机械地执行依据规则：裁判引用的每一条证据片段都会在成果中逐字搜索；未找到的片段将被丢弃；若没有保留的可靠证据，一个看似合理的失败判决将被降级为“干净”状态。 该规则会降低召回率，但我们接受这一点：一个本身伪造证据的伪造行为观察者会自我否定，而我们的方法已得到明确验证（§ 7，O2）。

The flag’s default is shadow; § 6 is the story of earning on .

paragraphs.en: Two-thirds of the corpus is structurally invisible to any content-reading observer. We consider stating this plainly a feature of the method: an observer evaluated only on the incidents it could possibly see would look far better than it deserves, and the per-incident scope label is what prevents that inflation. It also quantifies a design truth the prior paper argued qualitatively: most silent failure lives in seams and operations, not in content — a content observer is one instrument, not a panacea.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库的三分之二在结构上对任何仅读取内容的观察者而言都是不可见的。 我们明确陈述这一点，并将其视为该方法的一个特征：如果仅根据观察者可能观察到的事件对其进行评估，其表现会远优于实际水平，而每个事件的“作用域标签”正是防止这种虚高评价的关键。 这也量化了前一篇论文仅通过定性方式论证的设计真相：大多数静默故障存在于接口和操作中，而非内容本身——内容观察者只是一种工具，而非万能药。

paragraphs.en: From the in-scope incidents we derive the bench corpus (§ 5 ): Category A (6 regression cases — real historical fail-plausible artifacts the observer must catch deterministically, each bound to a ground-truth entry and tagged with the single detector it relies on, for sabotage); clean (4 legitimate synthesis outputs the observer must not flag — false-positive control); Category B (4 held-out cases: genuinely fail-plausible outputs for which no detection rule was designed — fabricated conference acceptances, paraphrased pollution with no literal error strings, fabricated co-authorship, unsupported strong claims from high-tier sources).
paragraphs.zh: 从范围内的事件中，我们构建了对照语料库（§ 5）：A类（6个回归案例——真实的历史失败且看似可信的产物，观察者必须确定性地检测出来，每个案例都绑定一个基准事实条目，并标记为所依赖的唯一检测器，用于破坏测试）；干净样本（4个合法的合成输出，观察者不得将其标记为异常——用于控制误报）；B类（4个预留案例：真正失败且看似可信的输出，但并未针对其设计任何检测规则——包括伪造的会议接受通知、没有字面错误字符串的改写污染、伪造的共同作者身份，以及来自高级别来源但缺乏依据的强烈主张）。

paragraphs.en: Labels were produced by the system’s two operators (human + AI collaborator); no independent annotators, no κ \kappa — inherited honestly from the prior paper, with the same mitigation: the labels are load-bearing, not descriptive. Each expected_signal drives a regression test whose outcome (“does the observer flag this artifact?”) is a binary fact, and each Category A label drives a sabotage test that fails CI if the label and detector disagree. Mislabeled ground truth does not silently bias a statistic; it breaks a build.
paragraphs.zh: 标签由系统的两名操作员（人类 + AI 协作方）生成；没有独立的标注员，也没有 κ — 这一点诚实地沿用了前一篇论文的做法，并采取了相同的缓解措施：这些标签是承重的，而非描述性的。 每个 expected_signal 都会触发一个回归测试，其结果（“观察者是否会标记这个人工产物？”）是一个二元事实；而每个 Category A 标签则会触发一个破坏性测试，如果标签与检测器不一致，CI 构建就会失败。 错误标注的基准数据不会悄无声息地影响统计量；它会导致构建失败。

paragraphs.en: For each Category A case, the harness disables the single detector the case relies on and re-runs: the case must slip from flagged to clean. All six do. This is chaos engineering [ 6 ] applied one level up — injecting faults into the guards rather than the system — and it exists because this runtime once discovered 67 governance checks that had been executing empty strings for months. In a silent-failure regime, an unvalidated detector is indistinguishable from a vacuous one; sabotage is the distinguisher. The harness exit code is a CI gate: defense must stay 100%, false positives 0%, every detector load-bearing. Held-out misses never gate — Category B is a measurement, not a target, and gating it would only pressure someone to quietly reclassify hard cases.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 A 类用例，测试框架会禁用该用例所依赖的唯一检测器并重新运行：该用例必须从“标记”状态变为“干净”状态。六个用例均如此。 这是一种向上一个层级应用的混沌工程 [ 6 ]——在守卫机制中注入故障，而非在系统中注入故障；之所以存在这种做法，是因为这个运行时曾经发现过 67 项治理检查，而这些检查数月来一直在执行空字符串。 在静默故障机制下，未经验证的检测器与空洞的检测器无法区分；而破坏行为正是区分二者的关键。 测试框架的退出代码是一个 CI 关卡：防御必须保持 100% 有效，假阳性为 0%，且每个检测器都必须承担负载。 预留的漏检案例绝不会触发关卡——B 类是一种测量，而非目标；将其设为关卡只会迫使有人悄悄地将困难案例重新分类。

paragraphs.en: The held-out result is the audit-as-regression finding pointed at our own instrument. Layer 1 catches exactly the patterns it was built from and is systematically blind to patterns it was not — a fabricated conference acceptance contains no error strings, no blood-lesson phrases, no forced-equivalence idioms; nothing lexical distinguishes it from a true report. Novel detection must come from Layer 2 semantics (grounding against source material), from the human eye, or from new rules earned by future incidents. The bench design encodes this honesty: a contributed case that Layer 1 cannot catch belongs in Category B by rule , documenting the frontier instead of debasing the regression set.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的结果是审计回归分析中发现的、针对我们自身工具的问题。 第 1 层恰好能捕捉到其构建时所依据的模式，但对未用于构建的模式则系统性视而不见——一个虚构的会议录用文本中不包含任何错误字符串、没有血淋淋的教训短语，也没有强行对等的习语；没有任何词汇特征能将其与真实报告区分开来。 新的检测能力必须来自第 2 层的语义分析（通过与源材料的对照），来自人类的眼力，或来自未来事件带来的新规则。 基准设计编码了这种诚实性：一个第 1 层无法捕捉到的贡献案例，根据规则应归入 B 类，从而记录这一边界，而非降低回归数据集的质量。

paragraphs.en: The corpus, detectors, harness, scorecard, and a byte-stable machine-readable manifest are released as a runnable bench (stdlib-only for the offline layer): clone, run one script, diff the manifest before/after a change to see whether the bench moved. The contribution protocol is CI-enforced — a new Category A case must actually be caught and its detector proven load-bearing; a new pattern the detector cannot catch is honestly logged as Category B until a rule or judge retires it. The bench is the breadth deliverable: it converts “we caught these in our system” into something others can run, reproduce, and extend with their own incidents.

paragraphs.en: Flip criteria (registered before reading shadow data): C1 — no unfixed systematic false-positive pattern (daily/multi-source recurrence); C2 — signal usefulness: ≥ 1 \geq 1 confirmed true positive or a clean window (flipping a clean detector adds no noise; its value simply remains unproven); C3 — sustainable cost (clean days must cost ≈ 0 {\approx}0 LLM calls). All three must hold. Rollback is a single-variable revert (mode flag back to shadow), which is what makes a lean-toward-flip posture defensible.
paragraphs.zh: 翻转标准（在阅读影子数据前已登记）：C1 — 不存在未固定的系统性假阳性模式（每日/多源重复出现）；C2 — 信号有效性：≥ 1 个经确认的真阳性或一个干净的窗口（翻转一个干净的探测器不会增加噪声；其价值仅保持未证实状态）；C3 — 可持续成本（干净日期的 LLM 调用成本必须 ≈ 0）。这三个条件必须同时满足。 回滚是一个单变量恢复（模式标志返回影子模式），这正是使倾向于翻转的立场具有合理性的原因。

paragraphs.en: Analysis protocol (frozen 2026-07-31, before the enforcing window’s data was read): field-level regime rules for every history row (which field, which value, assigns a row to shadow / on / boundary-excluded); a named exclusion rule for a known contamination source; window boundaries; the true/false-positive adjudication protocol (single-annotator, same-day, with an inconclusive bucket that never enters the precision denominator); a human-first race rule (any silent failure a human finds first is an observer false negative, logged and fed back); and a negative-results commitment : a quiet window must be reported as absence of evidence, never narrated as detection success — the paper about fail-plausible must not itself fail plausibly .
paragraphs.zh: 分析协议（于 2026-07-31 冻结，早于执行窗口数据被读取之时）：每行历史记录对应的字段级规则（指定字段、指定值，用于将某行归入“影子”/“开启”/“边界排除”类别）；针对已知污染源的命名排除规则；窗口边界；真阳性与假阳性的裁定协议（由单一标注员在同一日内完成，并设有无法定论的类别，该类别绝不会计入精确率分母）；以人为优先的竞赛规则（人类首先发现的任何静默故障均视为观察者的假阴性，并需记录后反馈）；以及阴性结果承诺：静默窗口必须被报告为“无证据”，绝不能被描述为“检测成功”——关于“失败合理性”的那篇论文本身绝不可出现不合理失败的情况。

paragraphs.en: Mechanical execution : when data arrives, the rules run as written; discovered protocol defects are disclosed as appended amendments, never silently rewritten.
paragraphs.zh: 机械执行：数据到达时，规则按原样运行；发现的协议缺陷将以附加修正案的形式披露，绝不会被静默重写。

paragraphs.en: Shadow mode’s first production run validated the phase’s existence: the deterministic boilerplate-repetition signal (S5) mis-fired on a legitimately repetitive star-rating field shared by roughly ten structured content sources — a systematic false positive that would have recurred daily in enforcing mode, burying real signal and depressing scores. It was diagnosed and fixed the same day, inside shadow: the rule gained a descriptive-character threshold separating rating-field repetition (legitimate structure) from descriptive-sentence repetition (the fabrication-shell fingerprint it was built for), a regression guard was added, and the offline scorecard was re-run (defense still 6/6, false positives still 0/4). The registered shadow window (2026-06-30 → \rightarrow 07-25, 26 days) then ran clean: zero fired verdicts. One detail deserves precision: the mis-fire occurred on the wiring-day run that preceded the registered window’s opening, so the window’s 26/26 clean days are all post-fix — which is exactly the state C1 asks a shadow phase to demonstrate.
paragraphs.zh: 影子模式的首次生产运行验证了该阶段的存在：确定性模板重复信号（S5）在一个由大约十个结构化内容源共享的、确实具有重复性的星级评分字段上错误触发——这是一种系统性误报，若在执行模式下每日运行，将会反复出现，掩盖真实信号并拉低评分。 问题在当天即被诊断并在影子模式内修复：该规则增加了一个描述性字符阈值，用以区分评分字段的重复（合法结构）与描述性句子的重复（其原本用于检测的伪造外壳指纹），同时添加了回归防护机制，并重新运行了离线评分表（防御力仍为 6/6，误报数仍为 0/4）。 随后，已登记的影子窗口期（2026-06-30 → \rightarrow 07-25，共 26 天）运行正常：未出现任何触发判定。 有一个细节需要明确：误报发生在已登记窗口期开启之前的布线日运行中，因此窗口期内全部 26/26 天的正常运行均发生在修复之后——而这正是 C1 要求影子阶段所必须展示的状态。

paragraphs.en: On 2026-07-24 the shadow data was pulled and the registered criteria were checked mechanically: C1 ✓ (the one systematic FP had been fixed in shadow; 14 consecutive final days clean); C2 ✓ (clean-window branch); C3 ✓ (clean days cost zero Layer-2 calls). Decision: flip. The mode flag went live on 07-25; the first enforcing-mode production day was 07-26. Two things about this decision are worth reporting precisely. First, it exercised the clean-window branch of C2 — we flipped a detector whose live value was unproven, because the registered criteria said a clean detector is safe to promote and waiting indefinitely for a positive is its own bias. Second, the act of grounding the flip mechanism before flipping caught two latent defects (§ 7 , O4–O5): the environment plumbing that was supposed to carry the mode flag to the process did not exist, and the observer’s own evidence file was being contaminated by its own test suite. A flip executed on vibes would have silently flipped nothing and then analyzed contaminated data.

paragraphs.en: H1 — live precision. Zero fired verdicts in 12 enforcing-mode days (double-sourced: per-day history fields and per-day report sections agree). The registered protocol speaks plainly: precision = TP / (TP + FP) is undefined at zero denominator, and no precision number may be reported. The precision evidence for this paper is therefore corpus-side only (6/6 ⋅ \cdot 0/4 ⋅ \cdot 4/4 with sabotage), plus one operational claim the window does support: twelve days of enforcing-mode integration produced no false-positive storm, no score disturbance, and zero marginal LLM cost — the flip was safe, whether or not it is yet useful.
paragraphs.zh: H1 — 实时精确度。 在 12 天的执行模式下，零次判定被触发（经双重来源验证：每日历史字段与每日报告部分的数据一致）。 已注册的协议明确说明：当分母为零时，精确度 = TP / (TP + FP) 无定义，且不得报告任何精确度数值。 因此，本文的精确度证据仅来自语料库（6/6 ⋅ \cdot 0/4 ⋅ \cdot 4/4，存在破坏行为），此外还有一个操作层面的主张得到了验证：为期十二天的执行模式集成未产生任何假阳性风暴、分数扰动或边际 LLM 成本——无论此举目前是否实用，其转换过程都是安全的。

paragraphs.en: The prior paper warned that an LLM judge “inherits every class in this taxonomy” and therefore “needs the same governance, provenance hygiene, and sabotage validation as the components it judges.” During this study the warning stopped being theoretical: the observer produced ten documented silent failures of its own between its first deployment and the end of the study window. Eight were carried in the first draft; a pre-submission reconciliation of the draft against the repository changelog recovered two more from inside the window (O9, O10), and we report the undercount rather than renumber silently — an observer’s incident log is itself a count that must reconcile against what happened (Postscript, P2). We report them as first-class data — to our knowledge the first incident log of an observability component for LLM systems, kept to the same postmortem standard as the system it watches (Table 5 , Fig. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 先前的论文曾警告称，LLM 裁判“会继承该分类体系中的每一类”，因此“需要与它所评判的组件相同的治理机制、来源验证和破坏性测试”。在本研究期间，这一警告不再只是理论上的：在首次部署到研究周期结束之间，观察器自身就出现了十起有记录的非显性故障。 初稿中记录了八起；在提交前将初稿与仓库变更日志进行核对，又发现了发生在研究周期内的另外两起（O9、O10）。我们选择报告这一漏报情况，而非悄无声息地重新编号——观察器的事故日志本身也需要与实际发生的情况进行核对（后记，P2）。 我们将这些故障作为一级数据予以报告——据我们所知，这是首个针对 LLM 系统的可观测性组件的事故日志，其记录标准与它所监控的系统遵循的故障后分析标准完全一致（表 5，图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Three readings. First, the distribution: the observer’s own failures span four of the five taxonomy classes, including three genuine fail-plausibles (O2: it fabricated a defect; O6: its deployment fabricated its own integration; O9: it twice accused a working mechanism). The inheritance claim is not rhetorical. Second, the discovery channels: not one of the ten was caught by the observer’s own operation in the ordinary sense — they were caught by human forensics, adversarial audits, the grounding discipline imposed by pre-registration (O4 and O5 specifically fell out of refusing to flip a switch without verifying the switch was connected), and, for O1 and O9, by a human reading the observer’s own output critically instead of trusting it. The observer watches the system; the method watches the observer. Third, the repairs held: the contamination-exclusion rule matching zero rows at analysis time (§ 6.4 ) is the audit trail that O4’s two-sided fix actually worked. A fourth reading was added at reconciliation: the log itself had been undercounted, and the same discipline that catches a synthesis footer overstating its sources (Postscript, P2) caught this paper understating its own.

paragraphs.en: We commend this practice — an incident log for the observability component, kept to the same standard as the system’s — as a concrete, checkable form of the “same governance for the judge” principle.

paragraphs.en: The Sunset Law standing rule in this runtime demands that new machinery name what it retires. The observer retires the human’s regression scanning : the portion of the weekly user-view ritual spent re-checking known fail-plausible patterns — error text posing as signal, boilerplate posing as content, forced analogies posing as insight, release claims posing as news — is now executed daily, deterministically, with sabotage-proven coverage of every documented in-scope pattern, at ≤ \leq 24h design latency against a historical human-detection record of 13 hours to 60 days. What it does not retire — by the audit-as-regression argument, cannot retire — is the human’s role as the novelty detector. The weekly ritual continues, re-aimed: less re-scanning of known patterns, more attention to the unknown. We consider “retire the scanning, keep the eye” the honest, defensible value proposition for observer components today, in contrast to claims that LLM judges can stand in for human oversight wholesale.
paragraphs.zh: 本运行环境中的“日落法则”常设规则要求，新机制必须明确说明其淘汰的内容。 观察者已淘汰人类的回归扫描：每周用户视角仪式中用于重新检查已知失败可能性模式的部分——伪装成信号的错误文本、伪装成内容的模板化内容、伪装成洞见的强行类比、伪装成新闻的发布声明——如今以每日固定方式执行，确保所有已记录的有效模式均被破坏性验证覆盖，设计延迟≤24小时，而人类检测的历史记录为13小时至60天。 根据“审计即回归”的论点，无法被淘汰的是人类作为新异度检测器的角色。 每周仪式仍在继续，但目标已调整：减少已知模式的重复扫描，更多关注未知内容。 我们认为，“淘汰扫描，保留观察”是当下观察者组件诚实且可辩护的价值主张，这与声称大型语言模型判断可以完全替代人类监督的说法形成对比。

sents.en: We consider “retire the scanning, keep the eye” the honest, defensible value proposition for observer components today, in contrast to claims that LLM judges can stand in for human oversight wholesale.
sents.zh: 我们认为，“淘汰扫描，保留观察”是当下观察者组件诚实且可辩护的价值主张，这与声称大型语言模型判断可以完全替代人类监督的说法形成对比。

paragraphs.en: Offline held-out recall is 0/4; live true positives are zero in a quiet window. On the evidence so far, the observer is a validated regression engine with an unproven predictive layer. What has changed is that the question is now instrumented : a grounded semantic judge exists behind the deterministic layer; a bench measures held-out recall and invites adversarial contributions; a frozen live protocol defines exactly what a predictive success or failure will look like (H1–H3) before it happens; and the corpus grows with every incident, each new postmortem becoming a labeled case within a day of closure. Prediction is no longer a claim to argue about; it is a number that will arrive.
paragraphs.zh: 离线保留集召回率为 0/4；在平静时段内，实时真正例为零。 根据目前证据，该观察者是一个经过验证的回归引擎，但预测层尚未得到证实。 变化之处在于，问题现在已被工具化：确定性层背后存在一个基于语义的判断机制；一个基准用于衡量保留集召回率并欢迎对抗性输入；一个冻结的实时协议在事件发生前就明确定义了预测成功或失败的具体形态（H1–H3）；并且随着每起事件的发生，语料库都会增长，每次新的事后分析都会在事件关闭后一天内成为一例带标签的案例。 预测不再是一个需要争论的主张；它将成为一个即将出现的数值。

paragraphs.en: The transferable method contribution is independent of our detector’s specifics: any team promoting any detector (LLM or not) from shadow to enforcing faces the same motivated-reasoning surface we did, and the same three-layer remedy applies — register flip criteria before reading shadow data; freeze the analysis protocol before the window opens; execute mechanically and disclose amendments. The practice composes with the shadow/canary deployment discipline that reliability engineering already teaches [ 7 ] ; what it adds is the binding of the promotion decision itself. The cost was two short documents written at the right time. The benefit, in our window alone: one systematic false positive retired before it could page anyone; two latent deployment defects caught because grounding-before-flipping is a registered step; three analysis-time temptations neutralized because the rules had already spent the judgment; and a negative result this paper can publish without embarrassment because publishing it was promised in advance. We would not deploy another observability component any other way.
paragraphs.zh: 这种可迁移的方法贡献独立于我们检测器的具体特性：任何团队，无论是否使用大型语言模型（LLM），只要将任何检测器从“影子”模式推进到强制执行阶段，都会面临与我们相同的动机推理问题，而相同的三层解决方案同样适用——在读取影子数据前登记翻转标准；在窗口开启前冻结分析协议；机械执行并披露任何修改。 这种做法与可靠性工程早已教导的“影子/金丝雀”部署规范相契合 [7]；它额外补充的是对升级决策本身的约束。 其成本仅为两份在恰当时间撰写的简短文档。 仅在我们这一阶段，其益处便包括：一个系统性误报在通知任何人之前就被消除；两个潜在的部署缺陷因“先建立基础再执行翻转”是已登记的步骤而被发现；三种分析阶段的诱惑因规则早已消耗了判断力而被化解；以及一个本论文可以毫无尴尬地发表的负面结果，因为提前已承诺会予以发布。 我们绝不会以其他方式部署任何另一个可观察性组件。

paragraphs.en: Two-layer economics held in production: 12/12 enforcing-mode days were clean and cost zero Layer-2 calls — the marginal cost of having the observer armed is the deterministic scan alone. This matters because observer components die of budget review: a design whose quiet days are free is deployable indefinitely, and quiet days are, we hope, the common case.
paragraphs.zh: 生产环节中维持的双层经济模型：在 12/12 个执行模式日中，均未产生费用，且 Layer-2 调用次数为零——使观察者具备武装能力的边际成本仅在于确定性的扫描。 这一点之所以重要，是因为观察者组件会在预算审查中被淘汰：一个在安静日无需付费的设计可以无限期部署，而我们希望安静日能是普遍情况。

paragraphs.en: The judge evaluates outputs of sibling LLM pipelines under the same roof, configured by the same operators who wrote this paper; model-level self-preference is documented [ 9 ] , and operator-level motivated reasoning is documented in our own § 6.6 . The mitigations — determinism-first, verbatim grounding, sabotage, read-only, pre-registration — are the paper’s method; § 7 is the evidence they were necessary; we do not claim they are sufficient, and an external replication of the bench on another runtime’s corpus is the experiment we most want to see.
paragraphs.zh: 法官在同一屋檐下评估了由撰写本文的相同操作者所配置的兄弟 LLM 流程的输出；模型层面的自我偏好已记录在文献 [9] 中，而操作者层面基于动机的推理则记录在我们自己的 §6.6 节中。 文中提出的缓解措施——优先确定性、逐字依据、破坏机制、只读模式以及预注册——构成了本文的方法；§7 节提供了这些措施必要性的证据；我们并未声称这些措施就足够了，而我们在另一个运行时环境语料库上对该基准的外部复现，正是我们最希望看到的实验。

paragraphs.en: The quiet window. Twelve observed enforcing-mode days contained zero manifested in-scope incidents: live precision, live latency, and live recall are all unmeasured. We cannot distinguish “nothing to catch” from “cannot catch” on live evidence — only the corpus-side results separate those hypotheses, and they do so only for known patterns. The window will lengthen; the registered protocol persists; the ledger is append-only.
paragraphs.zh: 安静的窗口。 十二个处于执行模式的观察日中，没有发生任何范围内的实际事件：实时精确度、实时延迟和实时召回率均无法测量。 我们无法通过实时证据区分“无迹可寻”与“无法捕捉”——只有语料库侧的结果才能区分这两种假设，而且这种区分仅适用于已知模式。 窗口将会延长；已注册的协议持续有效；账本仅支持追加操作。

paragraphs.en: Era mismatch (a confound we created). The corpus incidents (2026-04 → \rightarrow 06) drove defenses — context hygiene, provenance labeling, guard ladders — that plausibly lowered the base rate of fail-plausible artifacts in the deployment era (07 → \rightarrow 08). The observer may be guarding a door its own corpus helped close. We register the confound; the human-first race rule (H3) exists precisely so that any future incident, caught by either party, resolves it with data.
paragraphs.zh: 时代不匹配（我们制造的一个混淆因素）。 语料库事件（2026-04 → \rightarrow 06）推动了防御措施——上下文净化、来源标注和防护阶梯——这些措施很可能降低了部署时代（07 → \rightarrow 08）中失败可信人工制品的基础发生率。 观察者可能正在守护一扇其自身语料库帮助关闭的门。 我们记录这一混淆因素；人类优先竞赛规则（H3）的存在正是为了，任何未来被任一方发现的事件都能通过数据得到解决。

paragraphs.en: The prior paper ended with the image of the failure that should frighten an agent-system operator: the confident paragraph, on schedule, in perfect grammar, about a crisis that does not exist. This paper built the thing that is supposed to read that paragraph first. Against every such paragraph from our recorded past, it works — deterministically, provably, with each detector demonstrated load-bearing by sabotage. Against the paragraphs not yet written, it is honestly unproven: held-out recall 0/4 offline, a production window too quiet to score, and a predictive layer whose test will arrive on its own schedule under rules we froze in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 上一篇论文以一幅令智能体系统操作员胆寒的失败图景作结：一段自信满满、按时交付且语法完美的文字，内容却关乎一场并不存在的危机。 这篇论文构建了一个本应首先阅读那段文字的系统。 面对我们过往记录中所有此类段落，它都能奏效——具有确定性、可验证性，并且每个检测器都通过破坏性测试证明了其承载能力。 而对于尚未写就的段落，它目前尚无法被证实：离线测试中保留的召回率为 0/4，生产窗口过于安静以至于无法评分，而预测层的测试则将在其自身的时间表下、依据我们提前锁定的规则自动到来。

paragraphs.en: P1. The loop ran twice more. A sixth deterministic signal (2026-08-18). Reviewing a routine nightly synthesis, the human operator noticed two credibility-marker defects the automation had not: the synthesis had invented a provenance tier — an emoji marker outside the five-tier contract, wrapped in responsible-sounding hedging — and had upgraded a social-media source to an industrial-practice tier. Both are textbook fail-plausible: plausible-looking annotations, wrong by contract. Neither S1–S5 nor the existing credibility-mismatch rule could see them: S2 checks wording against a known single-source identity, while these were defects in the explicit markers of a multi-source synthesis document. The same day, the catch became S6 — a deterministic marker-contract checker that derives the legal tier set from the runtime’s provenance module (one source of truth, so a contract change updates the detector) and flags out-of-contract or contract-inconsistent markers. Against the same real artifact, S6 flags exactly the two human-caught defects and nothing else on the in-contract markers; sabotage confirms every branch load-bearing. Layer 1 is now six signals; the frozen sections above describe the five that existed inside the study window. A distribution detector born from an acceptance test (2026-08-28). A material-coverage regression family — the nightly cross-domain synthesis silently sourcing nearly all of its citations from a single calendar month, because a fixed positional sampling window was pinned to one end of an append-only archive — was caught twice by the human eye in quick succession (the first fix relocated the bias to the archive’s other end rather than removing it; only the second redesign made the sampling content-aware). When the redesign’s acceptance data arrived — a healthy five-month citation mix, judged by the human eye — the acceptance criterion itself was mechanized the same day: the daily observer now extracts date tokens from the synthesis deterministically and raises an anomaly when the cited months collapse (fewer than three distinct months, or one month above 80% of tokens). Against the accepted real artifact it stays silent; against the historical single-month shape it fires.

paragraphs.en: P2. What the second catch imposed on the fix itself. Section 6.6 reported the three times the frozen rules bound the analysis . The month-distribution episode showed that the fix needs binding too — the first repair had passed every test it shipped with and had still only moved the defect — and the operators codified five disciplines as a standing rule the same week. (1) A guard must assert what the user will see before it asserts that the mechanism works: the first fix shipped with twenty-two green guard tests, all of them mechanism checks, none asking what month mix the user would see. (2) A positional or capacity assumption is fixed as a class, not as an instance: the same pipeline carried a second positional window — an alphabetical truncation that had been silently dropping four sources from the synthesis for an unknown period while the footer counted them as analyzed — which the first fix never looked for. (3) The moment acceptance data can be narrated as “the design’s expected behavior” is the moment to attack one’s own fix: the all-August citation distribution had been rationalized, by the same pair that wrote § 6.6 , as the tail window working as designed, until the human looked at the product again. (4) Every reported count needs a test that reconciles it against what actually happened: the synthesis footer announced nineteen sources deep-analyzed while four had never reached the model’s context. (5) Capacity fixtures must be at production magnitude: the first guard’s fixture sat below the threshold it guarded and exercised the “fits, return unchanged” branch — a fake control that passed twice. Discipline (4) recurs throughout the rest of this postscript, and it is the discipline that found the undercount in this paper’s own Table 5 (§ 7 ).

paragraphs.en: P3. The observation plane fails plausibly too. The honesty split (§ 4.2 ) quantified the prior paper’s qualitative claim that most silent failure lives in seams and operations, not in content. The deployment era bore this out in a specific form. Between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-30, a series of adversarial code audits — a human reading the runtime’s own evidence mechanisms with one lens question, “what would this say if the thing it verifies had already failed?” — found a family of verifiers whose most reassuring output is produced precisely by their own failure. An audit log whose chain verifier returned ok when the whole log had been deleted. An integrity verifier whose only production call site ran its baseline-reset mode and never its verify mode, so that an emptied knowledge base would have been absorbed into the next baseline and reported intact the following morning. An SLO judge that scored two never-measured metrics as passing, because a sentinel value stood where a measurement should have been. A push-time secret scan whose “no leaks” line was indistinguishable from “the scanner could not run”. A failure-snapshot tool whose gateway-log path had no writer anywhere in the repository, and which its caller’s timeout killed in exactly the hung-service scenario it existed for, discarding the logs it had already collected. A critical “LLM completely unavailable” alert whose search string had never, in the monitored program’s entire history, been written — and which had a green unit test, because the test had fabricated the string. A claimed weekly upstream-upgrade monitor that for four months had no cron entry, no deployment, and no alert path; the monitoring existed only in documents. And a weekly health line, green every week for three months, that had been testing the fallback chain’s last hop as if it were the primary model: correctly answering a question that had expired.

paragraphs.en: We report this family for two reasons. First, it is the evidence-plane counterpart of fail-plausible — not an output that narrates an error as content, but a verifier that narrates its own failure as verification. Second, none of it was caught by the content observer, and none of it could have been: every item is in the § 4.2 “no” bucket, with no user-facing semantic artifact, and the honesty split exists precisely so that such incidents are reported as out of scope rather than quietly counted either for or against the instrument. The discovery channel for this class in the deployment era is adversarial code reading, upstream of manifestation, consistent with § 6.5 (H3). The balance has not shifted from the human to the machine; it has shifted from one human practice (looking at the product) to another (interrogating the verifiers).

paragraphs.en: P4. The inverse shape, and one that ran for five months. Three further post-freeze incidents are recorded because they extend the definition rather than fit it. In the first (2026-09-22), a job-level quality gate judged a correctly formatted analysis to be a parse failure — its “parse rate” compared rated items to input items, a ratio that had stopped meaning anything when the output format changed four months earlier — and discarded the report, so the user received only an alert: a healthy run narrated as a failure. In the second (2026-09-23), a delivery layer reported total failure whenever any one channel failed; eight hours of one channel being down produced false critical alerts, duplicate pushes, and every job recording its delivery as failed while the other channel had delivered everything. Success narrated as failure is the inverse of fail-plausible and shares its mechanism: a name — “parse rate”, “sent” — that no longer measured what it said. The third (found 2026-09-28) is the D3 shape in its purest form: for about five months, two ingestion jobs had called the knowledge-base writer with flags it does not parse; the writer discarded the content, wrote a note whose entire body was the first flag, printed “recorded”, and returned success — 327 such notes, entering the semantic index, the weekly review, and the nightly synthesis. It was found because the operator asked an unrelated verification question and a count that should have been positive was zero. None of the three lies in the observer’s scanned set; under the registered race rule (H3) they are charged to the human channel and, by the § 4.2 rule, to the out-of-scope bucket. They are the deployment era’s analogue of the corpus’s sixteen.

paragraphs.en: P6. The registered window, at revision time. Enforcing mode has run continuously since 2026-07-26. The append-only adjudication ledger holds no fired-verdict rows beyond the window-close entry, and a count check against the production score history on 2026-10-05 agrees: 56 enforcing-mode rows after the cutoff, none with a fired verdict. We have not re-tabulated § 6 (a count check is not a tabulation): the registered protocol requires a new cutoff to be declared before the data is read, and we decline to declare one in a revision made on the eve of submission; the quiet window stands as registered, and the next tabulation will append to the data inventory under its own cutoff. What has moved in eight weeks is the detector count (five to six), the observer’s own log (eight to ten inside the window, eleven overall), the disciplines that bind fixes (P2), and the evidence that the deployment era’s silent failures, like two-thirds of the corpus, lived where no content observer looks. The loop keeps running, and so does the paper’s standing conclusion: the mechanized eye needs watching — by method, not by hope.

sents.en: What has moved in eight weeks is the detector count (five to six), the observer’s own log (eight to ten inside the window, eleven overall), the disciplines that bind fixes (P2), and the evidence that the deployment era’s silent failures, like two-thirds of the corpus, lived where no content observer looks.
sents.zh: 八周以来发生变化的包括：检测器数量（从五增至六）、观察员自身的日志（窗口内从八增至十，总数达十一）、约束修复措施的规定（P2），以及证据表明部署时代的静默故障——如同语料库的三分之二——存在于没有内容观察员关注的地方。

sents.en: The loop keeps running, and so does the paper’s standing conclusion: the mechanized eye needs watching — by method, not by hope.
sents.zh: 循环持续运行，这篇论文的结论也同样成立：机械之眼需要被监督——通过方法，而非希望。

paragraphs.en: The labeled ground-truth corpus, two-layer detector, self-validation harness, scorecard, byte-stable bench manifest, and the pre-registered protocol documents (flip criteria, frozen analysis rules, decision records, and the append-only adjudication ledger) are public in the system repository, alongside the 28 incident postmortems and the governance framework described in the prior paper. The offline bench requires only a Python standard library. The daily observer job, its shadow/on mode flag, and the score-history data schema are in the same repository.
